title: DashboardGuardian
description: Guardian API (user-management service, AGB-904 section 4): student profiles, the parent gate and profile consent. All endpoints need an adult token; none is reachable from a student token (STUDENT_SCOPE_ONLY).

StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: A student profile (a User row with kind = student). `ageBandGuardian` is the same age in the two-band form user-management stores (under13 or 13to17), an optional alias next to the unchanged `ageBand`. Drift today: user-management sends and accepts the two-band value (under13 or 13to17) IN `ageBand` and does not use `ageBandGuardian`; this four-band `ageBand` and the alias are the contract's side. Convergence is tracked as a follow-up.

CreateStudentProfileRequest.title: CreateStudentProfileRequest
CreateStudentProfileRequest.description: POST /guardians/me/students: the profile and the consent in one call. `ageBandGuardian` is the same age in the two-band form user-management stores (under13 or 13to17), an optional alias next to the unchanged `ageBand`. Drift today: user-management sends and accepts the two-band value (under13 or 13to17) IN `ageBand` and does not use `ageBandGuardian`; this four-band `ageBand` and the alias are the contract's side. Convergence is tracked as a follow-up.

SetParentPinRequest.title: SetParentPinRequest
SetParentPinRequest.description: PUT /guardians/me/gate/pin. 4 to 6 digits. `currentPin` is required when changing an existing PIN.

ParentGateVerifyRequest.title: ParentGateVerifyRequest
ParentGateVerifyRequest.description: POST /guardians/me/gate/verify and /gate/switch-to-parent. 5 wrong tries lock the account and the device for 15 minutes (PIN_LOCKED).

ParentGateVerifyResponse.title: ParentGateVerifyResponse
ParentGateVerifyResponse.description: A short-lived (at most 5 minutes) parent-elevation token. See also `ParentGateVerifyResult`, what user-management answers today.

GuardianAgeBand.title: GuardianAgeBand
GuardianAgeBand.description: The two age bands the user-management service stores and the guardian API uses today. Mapping from the four contract bands (`ageBand`): 5-7 -> under13, 8-10 -> under13, 11-13 -> under13 (the band can hold 13-year-olds; the consent flow treats it as under 13), 14-17 -> 13to17. The mapping is one way: a two-band value does not say which four-band value it came from. `guardianAgeBandOf` in dashboard/index.js applies it. user-management puts this value in its `ageBand` field (not in `ageBandGuardian`).

ClaimStudentRequest.title: ClaimStudentRequest
ClaimStudentRequest.description: POST /guardians/me/students/claim: a guardian turns a Circle student into a guarded profile, by `studentId` (from claimable-students, the parent-email way) or by `claimCode` (from the Circle's admin or a teacher). Send exactly one of the two. Consent is recorded in the same step. `ageBand` is the two-band form user-management stores.

ClaimableStudentsResponse.title: ClaimableStudentsResponse
ClaimableStudentsResponse.description: GET /guardians/me/claimable-students: students whose parent email matches the guardian's.

ClaimCodeResponse.title: ClaimCodeResponse
ClaimCodeResponse.description: A one-time claim code, shown once; the Circle admin or a teacher hands it to the parent.

ParentGateVerifyResult.title: ParentGateVerifyResult
ParentGateVerifyResult.description: What user-management answers to POST /guardians/me/gate/verify today: `ok` and the time until which the guardian acts as the parent (5 minutes). The 2.20.0 `ParentGateVerifyResponse` (elevationToken, expiresInSeconds) is kept unchanged; apps accept either until the two are merged. See also `ParentGateVerifyResponse`.

LearnerRecordConsentRequest.title: LearnerRecordConsentRequest
LearnerRecordConsentRequest.description: PUT /learners/me/record-consent (2.23.0, adult token): a learner turns saving of their own notes on or off. The learner's own consent has its own text versions, separate from a guardian's. Refused for an account that may be a minor (a member of a minor Circle without an exempt role, an enrolment-consent holder, a student profile) and after an own erase (terminal).

over18Declared.description: The 18 or over declaration. Required (true) when `state` is `active`; the declaration alone is not trusted, the service also checks eligibility.

version.description: The own-consent text version shown to the learner. Required when `state` is `active`.

LearnerRecordConsent.title: LearnerRecordConsent
LearnerRecordConsent.description: GET and PUT answer of /learners/me/record-consent (2.23.0): the learner's current own consent.

StepUpMethod.title: StepUpMethod
StepUpMethod.description: How a fresh sign-in is proved before an own erase (2.23.0): password for password accounts, TOTP when MFA is on, both when both exist, a one-time code mailed to the verified address for social-only accounts with neither.

StepUpStartResponse.title: StepUpStartResponse
StepUpStartResponse.description: POST /learners/me/step-up/start (2.23.0, no body): the proof the learner must give. Limits are per user on the server (5 tries per code, one live code, 3 sends per hour and 10 per day, 15 minutes lockout after 5 failures in an hour).

required.description: Optional (2.25.0). Exactly which StepUpCompleteRequest fields the server will require for this step-up: `password` is the `password` field, `totp` is `totpCode`, `code` is the mailed `code`. Needed because `method` cannot say it all: a social-only account with MFA on needs BOTH the mailed code and the authenticator code, which `method` reports as `email-code`, so it is `["code", "totp"]`. Absent means infer from `method` as before (an older server). Clients must collect every listed proof before submitting, because a missing factor costs one try.

StepUpCompleteRequest.title: StepUpCompleteRequest
StepUpCompleteRequest.description: POST /learners/me/step-up/complete (2.23.0). Send exactly what `method` asks: `password`, `totpCode` or `code` (both `password` and `totpCode` for password+totp).

code.description: The 6-digit one-time code mailed for method `email-code`.

StepUpCompleteResponse.title: StepUpCompleteResponse
StepUpCompleteResponse.description: Answer of step-up/complete (2.23.0): a single-use ticket valid for 5 minutes, bound to the step-up record and the session, that the erase call needs. A refresh grant cannot mint one.
